{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nColumns:")
print(df.dtypes)

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("\nCount of -999 in biomarker_baseline:", (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("\nNumber of duplicate patient_id values:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check assay_batch values
print("\nUnique assay_batch values:", df['assay_batch'].unique())

# Check sample_seq distribution
print("\nMax sample_seq per patient:", df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().describe())"}
